verdict.rationale: Check is an API-first embedded payroll platform with public documentation. It covers creating, previewing, approving and deleting payrolls, managing companies, employees and contractors, API-key authentication with IP restrictions, a sandbox environment, and a Postman collection. A probe confirmed a live llms.txt describing the API specification. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the API end-to-end.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: This documentation guides you through the steps required to create, preview, approve, and delete a payroll object.
This guide will run you through our Postman collection that demonstrates how to create companies, workplaces, employees, and payrolls
Experiment with API calls without affecting real companies or employees
Check supports configuring IP restrictions on generated API keys for a layer of extra security.
Welcome to the API specification for Check!
